doc.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003

title: Working with the Adderleys and Nat's CD
summary: He shared concerts with Cannonball and Nat and played tuba on a Nat Adderley CD.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: Did you ever have occasion to work much with the Adderley brothers?

Not much but I have worked with them. One of my experiences, well I guess one of my main ways, not to work with but I worked on the same concert with Miles when Cannonball was there and Trane, and also when J.J. and Nat Adderley were together in the quintet. I was with Maynard and they were opening the concert with their band. And that was — but I’ve also recorded with Nat. I did a very bad CD with Nat too, I played very badly on that. It was very nice of him to give me the opportunity to do it. But I played some tuba on that CD.
What was the name of that?
I don’t know. I wanted to forget it.
Oh, okay. I probably have it.
He did some wonderful arrangements of things though.
